eye_controls.geometry: Visible eye patches, not full eyeball spheres. Test conservative gaze angles to avoid sliding/clipping.
eye_controls.weighting: Rigid per-side eye and corresponding highlight vertices; do not attach eyelashes to gaze bones.
eye_controls.pivot: Use fitted sphere centers only after practical pose/render check.

ear_controls.weighting: Use identical per-side height ramp on outer and inner ear surfaces; blend root to head, tip to ear bone.
ear_controls.collision: Geometry does not include collision response; inspect hair intersection at each desired pose.

recommendations.blink: No eyelid morphs or eyelid bones. Eyelashes are separate geometry; moving them alone cannot close the skin/eye opening. A proper blink requires sculpted eyelid shapes or manual facial skin weights followed by visual validation.
recommendations.jaw: No jaw/tongue/lip controls, no morph targets. A mouth-region component with internal depth exists in the body mesh; a proper speaking mouth still requires manual lip/cheek/inner-mouth weights and corrective morph authoring. Complete speech, teeth or tongue articulation have not been established.
recommendations.limits: This file records geometry feasibility only; it does not validate deformation or save changes to the model.
